headline: SGX Lists Four New ETFs Providing Access to US Tech and Global Blue Chips
summary: The Singapore Exchange introduced four new exchange-traded funds, providing domestic and regional investors simpler access to US technology leaders and global blue-chip equities.
why: The Singapore Exchange is Southeast Asia's primary financial bourse; expanding its ETF lineup broadens retail and institutional access to international equity markets.

impacts.name: Singapore Exchange Ltd
impacts.why: Broadening ETF listings enhances market depth, client participation, and trading clearing revenue on the exchange.
